sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status table)

values.note: 9 sites, each with a tent pad, fire grate and picnic table. Parking spurs are 25-35 ft (the forest's status table gives a 30-ft max spur); RVs and trailers must fit on the spur, since parking off road is not permitted.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/aspen-glen-campground ('Aspen Glen is a small 9-site campground'; 'RVs, trailers or other vehicles must fit on the parking spur because driving or parking off road is not permitted. The parking length ranges from 25 to 35 feet.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Aspen Glen | 9 | Max Spur 30'), read 2026-10-28

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/aspen-glen-campground ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Canyon Lakes Ranger District Campground Status: Aspen Glen, Operating Season 'May 22 - Sept 27'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come, first-served only; reservations are not accepted. Up to eight people per site.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/aspen-glen-campground ('First come, first served campground'; 'Reservations are not accepted.'; 'A single site may hold up to eight people.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions ('First-come, first-served'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $23 a site per night; 25% off when the water is off.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/aspen-glen-campground ('Single Site: $23 per night'; 'Fees are discounted 25% when water is off.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (Aspen Glen $23), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Interagency Senior and Access (and Golden Age / Golden Access) pass holders pay half the basic campground fee.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/aspen-glen-campground ('Interagency Senior, Interagency Access, Golden Age and Golden Access passes provide cardholders half price for basic campground fees.'), read 2026-10-28

note: USFS (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF, Canyon Lakes Ranger District), at 8,660 ft on the north side of paved CO-14 about 49 miles up the Poudre Canyon from US-287, along Joe Wright Creek. Aspen and mixed-conifer forest with an open meadow. --Claude
summary: FS campground page + ARP conditions table: confirmed 9 sites, vault toilets, potable water, FCFS only, $23. Added max 30 ft (spurs 25-35 ft), season 05-22..09-27, booking note, fees note (25% off when water is off), discounts; groups now manual. Note cleaned of field restatements.
flags: Missing phone: Canyon Lakes Ranger District 970-295-6600 (Fort Collins office, by appointment). The campground page gives no other contact.
Website is only the ARP recreation index; replace it with the campground's page, https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/aspen-glen-campground.
Max length: the campground page says spurs run 25-35 ft; the forest's status table says Max Spur 30'. Recorded 30. Every spur is at least 25 ft, so EKKO fits any site.

Riverfront (stored) is doubtful - re-audit lead, waterfront not changed. On imagery the loop sits in conifers between CO-14 and Joe Wright Creek; the site spurs end ~30-70 m from the creek with unbroken forest between (no open apron visible; imagery can only veto under canopy). The FS calls it 'along Joe Wright Creek' / 'adjacent to ... the Cache La Poudre River', which is a location claim, not a site-to-water one.
Pin 40.6192,-105.8184 is at the campground entrance on CO-14 (matches the FS lat/lng 40.619271,-105.818397), ~60-100 m from the sites. No per-site points exist (not on recreation.gov). OK.
Operator: no concessionaire is named on the FS page (none in the status table either).
